decision_policy: Counterexample-first and summation-first: verify the cheapest shell estimates and their limit order before treating no-incoming temporal decay as a spatial compactness mechanism. A surviving O(R) spatial multiplicity factor is a gluing failure, not a local mild-solution failure.
falsifiers: If ancient mildness does not license the restart identity at arbitrary t-T, reject the route.
If the heat term cannot be bounded by C A_*^{1/2} T^{-1/2}, remote linear ancestry is not eliminated.
If the projected Oseen kernel convolved with u⊗u is not integrable in time at infinity under A_*, reject absolute Duhamel-tail convergence.
If time-tail summability leaves spatial packet multiplicity uncontrolled, fail the proposed spatial bridge and preserve only temporal ancestry elimination.
Any use of finite total energy, global L3, compact orbit, or a non-NSE packet field as target-domain authority falsifies the claimed scope.
